units.source_text: 在里头的橱窗里摆着索尼牌小型收音机，连太吉郎他们也感到吃惊。

en.t: In the display case at the back were Sony brand small radios, which even surprised Taikichiro and the others.

units.source_text: 这些代售商品，尽管是为了“赚取外汇”，也未免太……

en.t: These consignment goods, even if they were meant to earn foreign currency, were really a bit too much...
